headline: Lebanon Valley leads the MACF in wins and goals
dek: Lebanon Valley won thirteen matches and drew two against four losses, pairing 42 goals scored with 23 conceded across all play. Sophomore forward Gavin Rapp accounted for sixteen of those goals, while Arcadia went unbeaten in conference play to finish close behind.

pattern.label: signal
pattern.text: Goal volume does not track the standings cleanly: DeSales scored 28 goals while absorbing ten losses to finish at the bottom of the table, whereas King's (Pa.) sits near the top despite sharing the conference's lowest scoring output.

wire.line: Stevens scored 40 goals from eighteen different scorers while conceding nineteen across all play.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches past their scheduled date carry no published result, and both belong to FDU - Florham: home dates against Ocean County and Wilkes.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: FDU - Florham conceded 42 goals across all matches, more than Stevens and Arcadia combined.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lebanon Valley forward Gavin Rapp leads the conference's scoring leaders with sixteen goals and two assists from 61 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: King's (Pa.) goalkeeper Ben Van Valkenburg made 75 saves and kept five shutouts while conceding nineteen goals.

last_match.line: Delaware Valley entered off consecutive shutout wins before the season's final match.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
